SIP::record-route
Description
This command gets SIP record-route header information, either at the index (a numeric zero-based index)
or by the keyword “top”. The “top” keyword will acess the first element as opposed to the first
line of the record-route headers.
Syntax
SIP
::
record-route
<
index
>
SIP
::
record-route
top
Examples
when
SIP_REQUEST
{
log
local0.
[
SIP
::
record-route
top
]
}
Related Information
